result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both drop the swoosh for a serif wordmark and a boxed L monogram. A's business card carries the full lockup (mark, wordmark, rule, est. line), but one logo variant is visibly clipped ('Larkspur Pa'). B has a cleaner, more confident mark and type, but its 'Reversed on ink' panel renders dark-on-white instead of on navy, and the visible card shows only the symbol with no wordmark.
